verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad () to these Mushrikun and Kafirun): “O Al-Kafirun (disbelievers in Allah, in His Oneness, in His Angels, in His Books, in His Messengers, in the Day of Resurrection, and in Al-Qadar, etc.)!
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.translation: “I worship not that which you worship,
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.translation: “Nor will you worship that which I worship.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.translation: “And I shall not worship that which you are worshipping.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.translation: “Nor will you worship that which I worship.
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.translation: “To you be your religion, and to me my religion (Islamic Monotheism).”
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali
